name: Water stability passes
description: Candidate has or needs evidence for water stability under aqueous glucose/NaHCO3 conditions.
descriptionZh: 候选物具备或需要补充葡萄糖/NaHCO₃ 水相条件下的稳定性证据。

name: Open metal site
description: Open metal sites may promote intermediate adsorption, C-C cleavage, and HCO3-/CO2 activation.
descriptionZh: 开放金属位点可能促进中间体吸附、C–C 裂解和 HCO₃⁻/CO₂ 活化。

name: Pore size allows diffusion
description: Pore accessibility may allow glucose and key intermediates to reach active environments.
descriptionZh: 孔道可达性可能允许葡萄糖和关键中间体进入活性环境。

name: Acid-base functional group
description: Functional groups may tune isomerization, cleavage, and by-product suppression.
descriptionZh: 官能团可能调节异构化、裂解和副产物抑制。

name: HCO3- / CO2 activation relevance
description: Candidate has a plausible link to bicarbonate/carbon dioxide participation in formate formation.
descriptionZh: 候选物与碳酸氢根/二氧化碳参与甲酸生成存在合理关联。

name: Suppress HMF / Humins side path
nameZh: 抑制 HMF / 腐殖质副路径
description: Candidate may reduce dehydration/polymerization side-path risk.
descriptionZh: 候选物可能降低脱水/聚合副路径风险。
